verdict.rationale: GitHub's REST docs confirm developers can create fine-grained personal access tokens and grant them specific permissions that define which API resources they can access. They also note that the X-Accepted-GitHub-Permissions response header reports the permissions an endpoint requires. The evidence covers token generation and scoping well but says little about ongoing management. Missing for 10: documented token management (listing, expiration, regeneration, revocation), classic-token coverage, independent or hands-on corroboration.
